name: Meghna Systems Limited
description: A Dhaka-based systems integrator delivering management information systems, e-government platforms and enterprise network infrastructure for public sector and development partner programmes.

services.name: Management information systems
services.description: Design, development and rollout of MIS platforms with dashboards, reporting and data quality tooling.

services.name: E-government platforms
services.description: Citizen-facing portals and mobile applications with single sign-on and payment gateway integration.

services.name: Enterprise network and data centre infrastructure
services.description: Supply, installation and support of switching, routing, servers, storage and virtualisation platforms.

services.name: Digital governance advisory
services.description: Assessments, roadmaps, capacity building and change management for public sector digital transformation.

services.name: Information security services
services.description: Security assessments, ISO 27001 readiness and security operations support.
